prompts.title: Upcoming at Family Church Students
prompts.setup: Lead these current ministry announcements with warmth and clarity. State only the details shown; do not guess a price or registration detail.

events.name: Wednesday Nights
events.when: Wednesday, October 21, 2026 · 6–8 PM · dinner starts at 5 PM
events.detail: Come hang out with us from 6 to 8 PM. If you want to come early for dinner, we start at 5, and there's pizza every week for just a dollar. Wednesday is the best place to get to know people and find your small group.

events.name: Middle School Sundays
events.detail: Middle school students gather for teaching and connection, with worship service options at 8:30 or 11:00 AM.
events.action: Invite a middle school friend this Sunday and connect with a leader at check-in.

events.name: Join our BAND app
events.when: Ongoing · get the current ministry updates
events.detail: BAND is where our student ministry shares announcements and keeps families connected across the week. Join at band.us/n/aaafbdF364s34. An admin approves each join request.
events.action: Join Family Students (WN) on BAND at band.us/n/aaafbdF364s34.

events.name: Pumpkin Party
events.detail: Pumpkin Party takes the place of our regular Wednesday night on October 28! Build a team of five and bring a pumpkin that weighs 10 pounds or more. It's also costume night, so come dressed up.
events.action: Get your team of five together and pick out a 10+ lb pumpkin.

events.name: 24-Hour Prayer
events.when: Friday, October 30 – Saturday, October 31, 2026 · times coming soon
events.detail: We're going to pray for 24 hours straight, from Friday, October 30 into Saturday, October 31. Middle schoolers can stay until 10 PM. Exact times and sign-ups are coming soon.
events.action: Save the date and watch BAND for sign-ups.

events.name: Wednesday Nights at Lakeside
events.detail: Wednesday nights are where we hang out, worship together, and get into small groups. If you haven't been in a while, this is your week to come back, and bring a friend with you.
events.action: Come this Wednesday and bring a friend.
